 Thu, 5 November 2026 
 By TRN Online, Kathmandu, Nov. 5: Janakpur Bolts and 
Lumini Lions are facing off in today's first match of the Nepal Premier League 
(NPL). 
 Wining toss today, Janakpur opted to fielding and 
Lumbini is bating in the NPL match being played at the TU International Cricket 
Stadium, Kirtipur. 
 In the ongoing season, Lumbini has stood unbeaten so 
far in three matches it has played, winning two matches and sharing score in a 
match which did not take place due to rains. 
 In its first match, Lumbini defeated Sudurpaschim 
Royals. The second match to be played with Chitwan Rhinos was canceled due to 
rains and the score was divided between the two clubs. In its third match, 
Lumbini had defeated Pokhara Avengers, scoring five points in total and placing 
itself as a top scorer so far. 
 Janakpur has so far played four games. It has won 
two games and lost in two others, placing itself in the fourth position out of 
eight teams of the NPL with four points.
